name: Audi R8 GT V10
description: The 2023 Audi R8 GT marks the final chapter of Audi's iconic mid-engine supercar, produced as a limited run of 333 units worldwide. Powered by a naturally aspirated 5.2-liter V10 FSI engine producing 620 hp and 565 Nm of torque, the R8 GT is the most powerful road-going R8 ever built. The high-revving V10, shared with the Lamborghini Huracan, screams to 8,700 rpm with an unforgettable exhaust note. Power is sent to all four wheels through Audi's legendary quattro system and a lightning-fast 7-speed S tronic dual-clutch transmission. Weighing just 1,570 kg thanks to extensive use of carbon fiber reinforced polymer, the R8 GT sprints from 0-100 km/h in 3.4 seconds and reaches a top speed of 320 km/h. Featuring unique GT styling cues, adjustable suspension, and ceramic brakes as standard, the R8 GT represents the ultimate expression of Audi's naturally aspirated supercar legacy.
